[[File:Flight_Controllers_SWA.png|thumb|right|250px|A flight controller in the Imperial Navy]]
A '''flight controller''' was an individual responsible for directing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in combat. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] relied heavily on flight controllers. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] experimented with flight controllers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], such as when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] directed the beginning attack runs during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
